Borage - 2x Plug Plants - Edible Wildflower 
Borage (Borago officinalis) Plug Plants - Easy, Edible, Great for Pollinators 

Annual herb, grows 50-100cm (20-40 inches) tall. 
Produces star-shaped, bright blue flowers all summer. 
Flowers and young leaves are edible - use in salads, drinks, or as a garnish. 
Attracts bees and other pollinators. 
Easy to grow in any well-drained soil, in sun or partial shade. 
Good for borders, wildlife gardens, and wildflower meadows. 
Spreading, branched habit with coarse, hairy leaves. 
Hardy in most UK gardens (RHS H5 rating). 

How to Grow: 

Plant in full sun or partial shade. 
Space plants 10-50cm (4-20 inches) apart. 
Water regularly, especially in dry weather. 
No special feeding needed.
